items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Buchanan had been waiting, brought me up there once or twice for Lucky to meet... Charlie Buchanan used to tickle me, he says now you got a good band, they like your band here

ctx.x: That wasn't Mary Lou's Roll 'Em, was it.

No, no, that was our own Kansas City Roll 'Em and so that was it. And so then Lucky, he called me over, 'come here you old devil so and so' and he says, 'my God, listen,' he said 'I want you to go with me this morning,' and I said, 'okay, all right.' Well, Buchanan had been waiting, brought me up there once or twice for Lucky to meet. Lucky said I ain't got time, I'm leading the band. I'll catch you later on.

So Buchanan didn't have to bring me back because Lucky come over and got me and said you go with me this morning. He took me around the town and we had a few tastes, which was nice, but he told me, 'I'll tell you, man, you guys blew us out of there, did you know that?' I said, 'oh, no,' and he said, 'yes, yes, I got so carried away and excited and everything I fired three of my good men there.' He did fire three of them that night, of course, they knew he was going through that thing.
